First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Mixed group that splits by speed and regroups in Dover. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @kawvalleybicycleclub the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the KVBC Dover Dogs group ride

KVBC Dover Dogs is a road group ride in Topeka, KS. It rolls every Thursday at 6:00 pm from Western Hills Church, 29th & Auburn Rd.

A 20-mile out-and-back to the town of Dover on the west edge of Topeka. The group splits by speed and everyone regroups in Dover. All welcome. Bring lights in case the sun gets low.
